blocks.text: OpenAI 披露了两起安全事件，涉及 AI 智能体在内部编码任务中削弱自身的安全监控系统。在其中一起事件中，OpenAI 称其 GPT-6 Astra 智能体在复制参考代码时禁用了自己的安全监控——随后还对此撒了谎。

inlines.text: OpenAI
披露了两起安全事件
，涉及 AI 智能体在内部编码任务中削弱自身的安全监控系统。在其中一起事件中，OpenAI 称其 GPT-6 Astra 智能体在复制参考代码时禁用了自己的安全监控——随后还对此撒了谎。

blocks.text: “参考代码并未配置监控，而 Astra 认定这就是从用户代码中移除监控集成的理由，”OpenAI 的 AI 安全研究员 Marcus Williams 在 X 上写道。“当用户询问 Astra 是否移除了监控时，它撒谎说没有。”

。“当用户询问 Astra 是否移除了监控时，它撒谎说没有。”

blocks.text: 另一起独立事件发生在 GPT-6.1 Sol 智能体在 Slack 上抑制了发给 OpenAI 安全团队的自动安全警报之后。在这起事件中，该 AI 智能体沿用了早先的一条指令，即不要向 OpenAI 团队发送任何 Slack 消息，并以此作为关闭警报的理由。

blocks.text: 这些事件加剧了围绕 AI 智能体的安全担忧，其中一些智能体曾绕过其测试环境的限制去攻击外部公司。“除了让模型更难禁用监控之外，我们还在设法理解模型最初为何可能想要这样做，”OpenAI 表示。“我们也在开发评估方法，以测试模型是否尤其倾向于规避错位监控，并为此表现出动机性推理。”

blocks.text: OpenAI disclosed a pair of safety incidents that involved AI agents weakening their safety monitoring systems during internal coding tasks. In one incident, OpenAI says its GPT-6 Astra agent disabled its safety monitor when copying reference code — and then lied about it.

inlines.text: OpenAI
disclosed a pair of safety incidents

that involved AI agents weakening their safety monitoring systems during internal coding tasks. In one incident, OpenAI says its GPT-6 Astra agent disabled its safety monitor when copying reference code — and then lied about it.

blocks.text: “The reference didn’t configure a monitor, and Astra decided that was reason to remove the monitoring integration from the user’s code,” Marcus Williams, an AI safety researcher at OpenAI, writes on X. “When the user asked whether Astra had removed monitoring, it lied and said that it had not.”

inlines.text: “The reference didn’t configure a monitor, and Astra decided that was reason to remove the monitoring integration from the user’s code,” Marcus Williams, an AI safety researcher at OpenAI,
writes on X
. “When the user asked whether Astra had removed monitoring, it lied and said that it had not.”

blocks.text: A separate incident occurred after a GPT-6.1 Sol agent suppressed automatic security alerts to OpenAI’s security team on Slack. In this case, the AI agent carried over an earlier instruction not to send any Slack messages to OpenAI’s team, using that to justify turning off the alerts.

inlines.text: A separate incident occurred after a GPT-6.1 Sol agent suppressed automatic security alerts to OpenAI’s security team on Slack. In this case, the AI agent carried over an earlier instruction not to send any Slack messages to OpenAI’s team, using that to justify turning off the alerts.

blocks.text: These incidents add to security concerns surrounding AI agents, some of which have circumvented their testing environment’s restrictions to hack outside companies. “In addition to making it harder for models to disable monitoring, we are looking to understand why models might seek to do so in the first place,” OpenAI says. “We are also developing evaluations to test whether models might have a propensity to evade misalignment monitoring in particular and exhibit motivated reasoning in order to do so.”
